en.name: Cinema
en.description: Watch movies and series from your own sources. Search catalogs, choose episodes, share a watchlist and resume locally, with playback speed and intro/outro skipping. No sources are bundled.

zh.name: 影视
zh.description: 用自己的影视源搜索电影与剧集、选集播放，收藏待看清单；观看进度保存在这台电脑，支持续播、倍速和跳过片头片尾。不内置影视源。
